description: Start here and call again whenever unsure. Returns the shared practice session as JSON: task (title, prompt and the goal conditions, each a sentence plus its formal form), state.objects (the live frames, steps and arrows keyed by id, with labels, positions, styles and arrow ends), step and revision (copy both into act), recent history, the last check and player-visible error explanations. Optional: detail "full" adds the action definitions, rules, task list and complete history; lang "en" (default), "de" or "both"; history = how many recent history items (default 5).
name: observe
